tool.name: GeneFior-Combine
tool.description: Combine per-sample detection matrices into combined matrices
tool.command:
mkdir -p input_dir output_dir &&
#for $dm in $detection_matrices: mkdir -p "input_dir/${dm.element_identifier}" && ln -s '${dm}' "input_dir/${dm.element_identifier}/user-provided-db_detection_matrix.tsv" && #end for
GeneFior-Combine -i input_dir
#if $samples_file: --samples-file '$samples_file' #end if
--output output_dir
$verbose
&& cd output_dir && det=\$(find . -name '*_combined_detection_matrix.tsv' | head -1) && mv "\$det" '$combined_detection_matrix' && dt=\$(find . -name '*_combined_detection_matrix_tools.tsv' | head -1) && mv "\$dt" '$combined_detection_matrix_tools' && evi=\$(find . -name '*_combined_evidence_matrix.tsv' | head -1) && mv "\$evi" '$combined_evidence_matrix'

param.name: detection_matrices
param.label: Per-sample detection matrices
param.help: A list collection of *_detection_matrix.tsv files, one per sample

param.name: samples_file
param.label: Samples file
param.help: Optional file with one sample folder name per line to include (defaults to all subdirectories)

tool.help:
@GENEFIOR_HELP@
**GeneFior-Combine** — Combine per-sample detection matrices
This tool combines per-sample `*_detection_matrix.tsv` files produced by multiple GeneFíor/AMRfior runs into per-database combined matrices.
**Inputs:**
- A list collection of detection matrix TSV files (one per sample) - Optionally, a samples file listing which sample folder names to include (defaults to all subdirectories)
**Outputs:**
- **Combined detection matrix** — Binary presence/absence matrix (genes × samples) - **Combined detection matrix tools** — Informative matrix where each cell lists which tools detected the gene in that sample - **Combined evidence matrix** — Qualified per-sample evidence statuses with evidence, candidate, exact, profile, and strict sample counts
